description: This file defines the final class GatewayMappingStrategies, which extends MappingStrategies, and manages instances of mapping strategies for various components of the Gateway service such as Things, Policies, ThingSearch, Connectivity, and global strategies. It includes singleton pattern implementation for the class instance, and constructs a composite MappingStrategies object aggregating strategies from different modules via a builder.
